(Capacity: 15,400) |champion = |bowl =[[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2016–17 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Iowa]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by seventh-year head coach [[Fran McCaffery]] and played their home games at [[Carver–Hawkeye Arena]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a four-way tie for fifth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2017 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to [[2016–17 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]]. They were one of the last four teams not selected for the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and thus received a No. 1 seed in the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 South Dakota Coyotes men's basketball team|South Dakota]] in the first round before losing to [[2016–17 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Hawkeyes]] finished [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] with a record of 22–11, 12–6 record in [[2015–16 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place in conference. In the [[2016 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they were upset by [[2015–16 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] in the second round. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]] in the First Round before losing to eventual National Champion, [[2015–16 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]], in the Second Round. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
